title: Manage an additional contact on an E-Toll Account
summary: This page explains how to manage or change an additional contact on your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account.
intro:
To manage an additional contact on your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account, you need to call 13 18 65 or visit a Service NSW Centre.

Changes you can make to an additional contact:
who_can_apply: You must be the account holder.

how_to_steps.text: visit a service centre with your supporting information.

internal_links.text: Add another person to an E-Toll Account

faqs.q: Who can manage an additional contact on an E-Toll Account?
faqs.a: You must be the account holder. An additional contact cannot make the change.

faqs.q: What do I need to manage an additional contact?
faqs.a: You need your E-Toll Account details, your email address, and the additional contact person's details.

faqs.q: How can I make changes to an additional contact?
faqs.a: You can call 13 18 65 or visit a Service NSW Centre.
